policy: Static analysis only. Preserve firmware, closed baseline, shared annotations/tooling and existing user files. One writer/private project per worktree; lane-only commits; parent integrates and reviews. No nested agents or device access.

lanes.decision: Identify native IPC channel (3,2) receiver and map request completion strength, without substituting controller channel (1,2).
lanes.gate: Original-ELF-bound route/decoder evidence, selected generated C and replay; explicit unclosed edges.

lanes.decision: Resolve rr_loader configuration/plugin ownership and heartbeat or SIGHUP handling relevant to map writers.
lanes.gate: Hash-bound host/config/handler evidence; distinguish plugin capability from active deployment and safe quiescence.

lanes.decision: Trace segmentation postprocessing and room-ID/name reconciliation after grid regeneration.
lanes.gate: Instruction-backed preservation/regeneration contracts, selected C and reproducible replay; no inferred edit safety.

lanes.decision: Resolve actual map database opener/journal configuration and vmap/config companions for a complete backup set.
lanes.gate: Hash-bound file/dependency evidence, selected C and replay; distinguish necessary files from a coherent snapshot barrier.

handoff: Each lane writes handoff.json with commits, identities, supported claims, checks, limits and next bounded targets. Parent acceptance follows execution and independent review.
next: Native event subscriptions/scheduling; concrete navigation/SLAM final callbacks and persistence completion; response-ID/name ordering; deployed DB root/journal and concrete vmap implementation. No operational acceptance.
